condition.i5_held_out_rule_composition.description: Swift-only trial. Taught rules A (repeatCollect), B (filterKeep), C (joinDash) individually with isolated examples; withheld all combination examples. Trial task required composed functions taskAC (A+C), taskBC (B+C), taskABC (A+B+C), fixed before observing results.
condition.i5_held_out_rule_composition.verification: Compiled and ran generated Swift source via `swift check_i5.swift` with assertions covering taskAC, taskBC, taskABC against hand-derived expected outputs; exit_code 0, printed I5_OK.

condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.description: Swift-only trial. Reversible counterfactual keyword mapping (loop<->conditional, branch<->iteration, sum<->multiplication, product<->addition) applied to the English task description only; spec stated mapping unambiguously; underlying computation (even x -> x*2 else x+3, then sum) unaffected -- mapping does not alter real program result, matching methodology's 'do not use semantic traps that alter the actual result' constraint.
condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.verification: Compiled and ran generated Swift source via `swift check_i6.swift` comparing model's compute() to an independently written reference implementation over two test arrays; exit_code 0, matching outputs (30,30), confirming the model followed the supplied (conflicting) mapping specification rather than prior lexical expectations of 'sum'/'product'/'loop'/'branch'.
